metadata.description: Free tools for building with Claude, each one used for real before it is handed over.

plugins.name: heard
plugins.description: Claude says back what you asked for before it starts.

plugins.name: slingshot
plugins.description: Before a big job starts, Claude shows you the most ambitious version worth doing as a short plan, and you choose.

plugins.name: yes-chef
plugins.description: Before a big or fuzzy job starts, Claude reads it back, shows the most ambitious version worth doing, asks every question that would change the work, and hands you the exact prompt it will run from.
